title: Rewind to the replay position
statement: Let $x,a$ be Boolean words and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$. For every natural number $j\le |a|$, starting in state $2$ with $a$ stored on the work tape, the work-tape head at position $j-1$, and empty output, after $j+1$ steps the machine is in state $3$ with the work-tape head at position $0$; the input-head position, stored word, and empty output are unchanged.
replaced:
From the stripping machine's rewind state with buffer $a$ and work head at
displacement $j-1$, for any $j \le \abs{a}$, exactly $j+1$ steps return the
work head to displacement $0$ and enter the replay state, emitting nothing.
